data.body: Fourth plan review returned BLOCK because inline diff-only eval cases cannot exercise the approved second-source repository rule. Expanded the plan by two files. `eval_solver.py` will reuse its existing disposable fixture repository for code-review cases that supply `files`, while preserving the current inline path for all other cases. `test_eval_solver.py` will pin rerooting. The documentation spec will carry repository-backed cases, registered deterministic scorers, a non-empty gold set, and an explicit repository-wide-no-owned-location no-fire case.
